part.text:
Fixed. The NPE happened because when `@UtilityClass` marks a nested class static, javac's stale cached `erasure_field` (computed while the class was still an inner class) corrupted type inference. Changes:

- `src/core/lombok/javac/JavacAST.java:641` — reset `innerClassSymbol.erasure_field = null` when making the nested class static (alongside the existing `setEnclosingType` fix)
- `src/stubs/com/sun/tools/javac/code/Symbol.java` — added the `erasure_field` field to the javac6 compile stub

Verified with `ant test.javacCurrent` in the container: `javac-UtilityClassGeneric.java` (the FAIL_TO_PASS case) now passes, and the full `lombok.TestJavac` suite passes.
